minor.issue: Contract change: groupBookingDepositPolicyValue is now null when type is NONE (legacy NOT NULL column returned 0). properties.mapper.ts nulls it deliberately; apps/web settings page tolerates it (?? 0), but any other consumer doing arithmetic/toFixed on the field will break. Document in the API/Swagger + release notes.

Still no way to READ a rate-plan-scoped policy (getOne forces ratePlanId IS NULL, no query param), so rate-plan overrides used by PolicyResolverService cannot be inspected via API. Carried over from iteration 5.
Deposit normalizer accepts a NEGATIVE value for a NONE policy (normalize-deposit-policy only rejects value > 0), silently coercing it to 0 instead of 400.

critical_code_review_comments: properties.service.ts update(): the base property save and policiesService.upsert() run in two separate transactions. Today no reachable divergence exists because UpdatePropertyDto validation mirrors the normalizer rules (verified: a rejected PERCENTAGE 101 payload leaves name unchanged), but any future normalizer-only rule (or a DB error inside upsert) would commit the base fields and then 400 - wrap both in a single transaction/queryRunner.

Deposit rules are duplicated in UpdatePropertyDto (validate() messages) and normalizeDepositPolicy(); they must be kept in sync or the facade and direct policy endpoint will diverge in error behaviour. Prefer delegating DTO validation to the shared normalizer.

PropertiesController.toResponse() issues one policy-resolver query per property in findAll (Promise.all over the page) - N+1 on the property list; batch-load GROUP_DEPOSIT rows by propertyId when multi-property support lands.
